entities.name: Najal
entities.description: Efreet wizard from Rabiah who claims to be the fastest efreet; crossed into Dominaria after being caught in a desert cyclone. Not a planeswalker.

entities.name: Tivan Desert
entities.description: Desert on Dominaria where Najal found herself lost.

events.summary: Challenged to a race, Najal was beset by a desert cyclone and found herself lost in the Tivan Desert on Dominaria.
